note: The Indonesia regional offers page https://www.specialoffers.jcb/id/offers/d/southeast-and-south-asia/indonesia/ loads its tiles from this public JSON file (137 entries on 25 Nov 2026, equal to the category counts on the page: restaurant 119, retail store 4, relaxation 4, leisure 3, hotel 3, others 3, transport 1). The English page https://www.specialoffers.jcb/en/offers/d/southeast-and-south-asia/indonesia/ returns an empty list, so the Indonesian pages (/id/) are the listing for this location. Each entry is one offer page /id/offers/detail/A-xxxxxxxx-07/; the item key is the last path part, which is the source_key of the hand-in. The Note text starts with the eligibility sentence ('Semua pemegang kartu kredit JCB', 'Subjek hanya untuk pemegang kartu yg diterbitkan di Indonesia' or 'Subjek hanya untuk pemegang kartu tertentu saja'); read the next lines for Ultimate-only perks. The coupon block holds 'Valid :YYYY-MM-DD - YYYY-MM-DD', which gives the start and end date. Offers whose end date is before the run date are still listed on the site: leave them out and count them. Pages with more than one deal (for example Papaya, REGAL, Nomuji, Dandelion, Iseikai) are handed in as benefit-1, benefit-2 and so on.
